summary: Add a compiled Domain assembly reference check as a supplemental LayerGuard detector.
plan: Read allowedReferences.Domain from the existing src/layerguard.json authority; inspect direct references in compiled Domain assemblies. Keep LayerGuard project graph and baselines unchanged. Prove allowed, forbidden and missing-assembly outcomes with generated fixture DLLs, then run the detector after Release solution build in its own CI job. Retain ARCH.SEMANTIC as advisory because assembly references do not establish per-symbol or runtime behavior.
